settings.title: Sales Settings
settings.subtitle: Document numbering, lock policies, payment terms, features and tax rules.
settings.featuresHint: Enable or disable optional Sales capabilities.
settings.currencyHint: Base currency used by documents. Documents may carry another currency when multi-currency is on.
settings.pricingHint: Price source precedence, custom prices and the missing-price policy.
settings.resolutionPriceBookFirst: Price book first, then product price
settings.resolutionProductFirst: Product price first, then price book
settings.allowCustomPriceHint: Users with the permission may type a price instead of using a resolved one.
settings.missingPricePolicyError: Require a price (never default to zero)
settings.taxHint: Tax codes, rounding stages and the missing-tax policy.
settings.missingTaxPolicyError: Require a tax code on every line
settings.shippingTaxCodeHint: Tax code applied to shipping charges; empty means shipping is not taxed.
settings.numberingHint: Series-level allocation policy for document numbers.
settings.allocationIssuance: At issuance (drafts do not consume numbers)
settings.inventoryHint: Stock policy, reservation strategy and removal method.
settings.defaultWarehouseIdHint: Used when a stock-moving document names no warehouse.
settings.allowNegativeStockHint: Refused by default; an override requires a dedicated permission and reason.
settings.variantsHint: Configurable variant attributes — not hard-coded industry attributes.
settings.attributesHint: What a product in a family may specify. `code` is stored, `label` is shown.
settings.label: Label
settings.subscriptionsHint: Recurring billing policy, horizon and per-run limits.
settings.notAdmin: Only administrators can change Sales settings.
settings.warningsHint: Review these before enabling dependent features.
settings.priceBooksDisabled: Price books are disabled but price resolution still prefers them; product prices will be used.
settings.noPriceSource: Both product prices and price books are disabled: every line needs an explicit price.
settings.purchasesWithoutSupplierPrices: Purchases are enabled while supplier prices are disabled; purchase orders will need manual prices.
settings.inventoryWithoutPurchases: Inventory is enabled without purchases; stock can only change through sales documents and adjustments.
settings.multiCurrencyWithoutBase: Multi-currency is enabled but no base currency is configured.
settings.inventoryWithoutStockManagedTypes: Inventory is enabled but no product type is stock-managed; no document will move stock.
settings.inventoryAllowsNegativeStock: Negative stock is allowed: a movement will be written even when the warehouse holds less than it is asked to release.
settings.productVariantsWithoutAttributes: Product variants are enabled but no variant attributes are configured; a product cannot join a family yet.
settings.removalPolicyWithoutInventory: A removal policy is configured while inventory is disabled; no picking will happen until it is on.

lineItem.searchProduct: Search products by name or SKU…
lineItem.customLineHint: A line without a product. Requires the custom-line permission.
lineItem.priceUnresolvedHint: No price book entry, product price or explicit price applies to this line.
lineItem.taxMissingHint: Configure a tax code or set the missing-tax policy to allow zero tax.
lineItem.totalMismatch: Server-calculated totals differ from the client's values. Server values win.
